historical_commentary.text: This note explains how to enable/disable individual tabs in 4D V6's then-new tab control, a still-conceptually-relevant UI pattern (navigable multi-page forms), by manipulating list item properties; the specific commands referenced (Selected list item, SET LIST ITEM PROPERTIES) are classic 4D language commands that remain present in the modern 4D language, though today's UI/form design work would more likely leverage newer form object and page-management capabilities introduced since V6.
related_updates: The classic 4D commands referenced (Selected list item, SET LIST ITEM PROPERTIES) remain part of the current 4D language, so the core technique is largely still applicable

4D has since introduced richer form/page management features and object properties (including modern list boxes and tab/page controls with more built-in options) that may reduce the need for this manual list-item-property workaround
